# Mollo Planer MCP

Project planning (Project > Milestone > Todo > Task) for agents. JSON-RPC over POST. You act as the account of your token, with its exact permissions.

- Server: https://api.planer.example.com/mcp (the address of this installation)
- Agents: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` of their own agent account (the administrator makes it). The token is a secret: never in prompts, files, logs.
- People: Custom Connector with OAuth (Claude: Settings > Connectors; no token, your rights). Not for agent accounts.
- Claude Code: project `.mcp.json`, `{"mcpServers":{"mollo-planer":{"type":"http","url":"<address>","headers":{"Authorization":"Bearer ${MOLLOPLANER_<NAME>_TOKEN}"}}}}`; the variable lives in the environment, never in the file.
- Human guide: /mcp/ (English), /mcp/de/ (German)

## Work cheaply (a whole plan is 15-25k tokens; most tasks are done)

| Want | Call | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| who you are | `whoami` (check first) | ~0.1k |
| projects, revision | `list_projects` | ~0.3k |
| get an overview | `export_plan` `view: "outline"`, or `get_project_statistics` (numbers) | ~1k |
| open work | `list_tasks` `assignee: "me"`, `status`, `todo_ids`, `labels` | ~2k |
| one task | `list_tasks` `ids`, `include: ["description","comments"]` | small |
| status, commit, title, labels | `update_tasks {tasks: [{id: "k-123", status: "done", commit: "abc1234"}]}`. No export, no dry run | small |
| new task or todo | `import_plan` `mode: "partial"`, `append_only`, only the ids of milestone and todo plus `k-new-1`, `dry_run` first | ~0.2k |
| other changes | `export_plan` for one milestone, edit, `import_plan` partial; `base_revision` guards | 2k |
| re-order | `reorder` (all sibling ids, or `by: "version"`); to another parent: `import_plan` | small |
| whole plan | `export_plan` unfiltered: a backup only | 15-25k |

## Recipes

- New project from a template: `list_templates`, then `import_plan` without project_id, with `template_id`; `dry_run` first.
- Comment: `add_comment {task_id: "k-123", text: "..."}`.

## Do not

- Export the whole plan to look around (use outline, statistics, `list_tasks`).
- Send an excerpt with `mode: "full"` (refused; use `partial`).
- Set the status of a milestone or todo (derived from tasks).
- Put a token in files or prompts.

## Tools

| Tool | Does | |
|---|---|---|
| whoami | the account you act as | read |
| list_projects | projects, role, revision | read |
| list_templates | project templates | read |
| list_users | accounts, or project members | read |
| export_plan | plan as planer-v2 JSON, or outline | read |
| list_tasks | tasks flat, one with detail | read |
| get_project_statistics | numbers of a project | read |
| list_comments | comments of a task or project | read |
| list_ideas | your private ideas | read |
| get_project_ai_context | background notes | read |
| import_plan | write a plan (full or partial) | write |
| update_tasks | status, commit, assignee of tasks | write |
| reorder | order siblings, milestones by version | write |
| add_comment | comment on a task | write |
| create_idea | save a private idea | write |

## Rules and limits

- IDs: `m-<id>`, `t-<id>`, `k-<id>`; new items `m-new-1`, `t-new-1`, `k-new-1`. Lists have `has_more` and `next_cursor`.
- Markdown in descriptions and comments: paragraphs, H2/H3, lists, quotes, bold, italic, inline code, links (http, https, mailto). No HTML, images, tables, code blocks.
- Assignees are project members, by email. Mails only with `notify_assignees: true`.
- Limits: 200 milestones/project, 50 todos/milestone, 50 tasks/todo, 50 members, 30 labels, titles 2 to 160 characters, descriptions 5000 characters.
- Format schema: `/mcp/format-v2.schema.json`. Unknown fields are refused with the path and a suggestion.
